display_long_description:
Ever wanted to take a wrecking ball to a building? Or bring down an entire tower with a carefully planned demolition?

Wreck the Block! puts you in control in a colorful VR demolition game where smashing buildings is only half the fun.

Take the operator's seat in a massive crane, build momentum with the wrecking ball, and send bricks flying. You'll tackle demolition jobs that test timing, accuracy, and control. When needed, hop into a front-end loader and clear the rubble.

If explosives are more your style, take a different approach. Place charges, connect detonation cord, set up your firing sequence, and stand back to see how your plan unfolds. There's something satisfying about watching a building come down exactly the way you intended.

Not every job is about destroying everything in sight. Some require a careful touch, while others reward you for making as much of a mess as possible. Earn stars, improve your scores, and see how you stack up against other players on the leaderboards.

Whether you prefer heavy machinery or controlled demolition, there's plenty to wreck.

Wreck the Block! — The demolition is in your hands.

Music credits:
Music: 'Undefeated' by Hey Pluto! on #Uppbeat https://uppbeat.io/c/hey-pluto
Music: 'Nod Your Head' by Hey Pluto! on #Uppbeat https://uppbeat.io/c/hey-pluto
Music: 'Daiquiris' by Hey Pluto! on #Uppbeat https://uppbeat.io/c/hey-pluto
